name: DomToRaj Integration
author: domtoraj

sections.description:
This plugin connects your WordPress site to your DomToRaj.pl agency account.

  • Imports listings as a custom post type (domtoraj_property, labeled “Nieruchomości” in the admin), with prefixed taxonomies for offer type and location. Public URLs use the /nieruchomosci/… rewrite base (singles and archive).
  • Automatic synchronization (WP-Cron, hourly by default) plus manual sync from the admin screen.
  • Shortcodes for a searchable list you can place on any page.
  • Data is fetched from the official DomToRaj API (requires the Business plan on your DomToRaj account).

DomToRaj requirements

  • An agency or developer account on domtoraj.pl.
  • An active Business plan and valid agency ID and API key from the integration / API section in your account.

If the Business plan is not active, the API returns a permission error; the plugin shows the message in the admin and during sync.

External services

This plugin connects to the external DomToRaj API service to download agency data and property listings required to display offers in WordPress.

Service provider: DomToRaj.pl
Service URL: https://domtoraj.pl/

Data sent and when:
* Agency ID (configured in plugin settings) is sent in the API endpoint path on each sync request.
* API key (configured in plugin settings) is sent in the X-Api-Key request header on each sync request.
* Requests are sent when the admin runs manual sync and during scheduled WP-Cron synchronization.

Terms of Service: https://domtoraj.pl/p/regulamin-dla-biur-nieruchomosci
Privacy Policy: https://domtoraj.pl/p/polityka-prywatnosci
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory (once published) or upload the domtoraj-integration folder to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin under Plugins.
  3. Go to DomToRaj → Settings, enter your agency ID and API key, and save.
  4. Run Sync now or wait for the scheduled sync.
  5. Create a results page and add the shortcodes [domtoraj_wyszukiwarka] and [domtoraj_lista_ofert] (in that order) to the content.
sections.faq:
Where do I get the agency ID and API key?

Log in to domtoraj.pl, open Integration / API in your agency settings, and copy the values into the plugin.

Why does sync return HTTP 403?

Usually: inactive Business plan, expired subscription, or wrong API key / agency ID. The API message is shown in the plugin admin.

Does the plugin work with the free Start plan?

No. WordPress listing sync requires the Business plan on DomToRaj.

How do I show listings on the home page?

Use [domtoraj_lista_ofert] with optional attributes, e.g. [domtoraj_lista_ofert limit="6" typ_oferty="sprzedaz"] (typ_oferty and lokalizacja are shortcode attribute names; they filter by term slug on the plugin taxonomies).
sections.changelog:
1.0.15

  • WordPress.org guidelines: prefixed internal identifiers for the listings post type and taxonomies (domtoraj_property, domtoraj_offer_type, domtoraj_location); automatic one-time migration from older unprefixed keys; public rewrite base remains /nieruchomosci/.
  • Permalink fix: rebuild rewrite rules on init (after CPT registration), not during plugins_loaded migration — avoids missing rules and 301/404 to the homepage after the CPT rename.

1.0.14

  • Security and compliance update: stricter agency ID sanitization and documented external service links (terms and privacy policy).

1.0.13

  • Minor fixes and API compatibility (including error messages from message / error fields).

1.0.0

  • Initial release: CPT, taxonomies, sync, shortcodes, templates.
